editorial_policy: Exclude weapons, ammunition, cyberware, drugs, explicit combat gear, plot evidence, corpses/body parts, poisons, and hazardous/industrial cargo from the consumer vocabulary.
Prefer links to existing official catalogue products over duplicate vocabulary concepts.
Treat form factor, style, material, condition, size, packaging, and branding cues as descriptors when they do not define a distinct rules item.
Semantically deduplicate near-identical source outcomes into one consumer concept.
Do not infer meaning for unclear source text; unclear outcomes remain excluded pending review.
